name: Maximum sum of pairwise-coprime interval integers
description: construct() -> nonempty distinct Python integers from 1..256. Every pair must have greatest common divisor one. Maximize their exact sum. Integer one is allowed once. The local inclusive interval [1,256] is G(257) under the source’s strict endpoint convention. The prime baseline is a local elementary construction; no asymptotic result, global characterization, or optimal score is claimed.

sources.locator: Paul Erdős, On two unconventional number theoretic functions and on some related problems (1984 bibliography; scanned volume marked 1983). Page 120, equation (29), defines G(n) as the maximum sum of pairwise-coprime positive integers below n; equation (30) states an asymptotic result credited jointly to Erdős and van Lint.
